card.title: Nintendo Switch Not turning on, draws 0.2A @ 15V from charger and slowly drops Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Not turning on, draws 0.2A @ 15V from charger and slowly drops Repair

claims.statement: Switch drawing ~0.2 A at 15 V that slowly drops (~0.275 A with battery unplugged) likely has a dead CPU; check the CPU caps by M92T36 and by the SOT-323-6 IC near MAX17050—both shorted means the board is unrecoverable.

procedure: Check the two CPU capacitors for shorts.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
